articles.title: Artistas e famosos comemoram reeleição de Lula para o 4º mandato | G1
articles.standfirst: Marco Pigossi e Fátima Bernardes estão entre os famosos que celebraram a vitória do petista sobre Flávio Bolsonaro.
articles.summary: Marco Pigossi e Fátima Bernardes estão entre os famosos que celebraram a vitória do petista sobre Flávio Bolsonaro.
articles.body:
Famosos e artistas comemoraram a reeleição de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). Ao derrotar Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), o petista se tornou o primeiro presidente do Brasil eleito quatro vezes pelo voto popular.

O ator Marco Pigossi afirmou que "o povo brasileiro é gigante". A apresentadora Fátima Bernardes também celebrou: "Um agradecimento a todos que colocaram as diferenças de lado e escolheram a democracia e a liberdade".

articles.title: 'Udta Teer' box office collection day 3: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan’s film earns Rs 8.10 cr on Sunday; opening weekend shows steady growth
articles.summary: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan’s 'Udta Teer' had its highest single-day India net collection on Sunday, earning Rs 8.10 cr.
articles.body: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan’s 'Udta Teer' had its highest single-day India net collection on Sunday, earning Rs 8.10 cr. The spy comedy rose 11.7% from Saturday’s Rs 7.25 cr. According to the Sacnilk report, the film earned Rs 8.10 cr from 6,020 shows across India. Its worldwide gross collection has now reached Rs 27.58 cr.'Udta Teer's opening weekendThe film opened with Rs 4.10 cr in India net collections on Friday, October 23. Saturday earnings rose to Rs 7.25 cr before Sunday brought another increase. The three-day performance took the film’s cumulative India net collection to Rs 19.45 cr. Its domestic gross has reached Rs 23.08 cr.Overseas markets contributed Rs 1.75 cr on Sunday, taking the cumulative international gross to Rs 4.50 cr. The film also recorded 361,245 ticket sales on its third day. Total footfalls across its theatrical run have reached 866,929.Occupancy on SundayThe film’s reported occupancy increased from 13% on Friday to 21% on Saturday, before reaching 25% on Sunday. The latest figures indicate a steady improvement in audience attendance during its opening weekend.| Day | Date | India net collection | Shows | Occupancy || Day 1 (Friday) | October 23, 2026 | Rs 4.10 cr | 6,265 | 13.0% || Day 2 (Saturday) | October 24 | Rs 7.25 cr | 6,164 | 21.0% || Day 3 (Sunday) | October 25 | Rs 8.10 cr | 6,020 | 25.0% |The Hindi 2D version recorded an overall occupancy of 35.91% on Sunday. Evening shows led with 47.08%, followed by afternoon screenings at 39.54%. Night shows registered 37.46%, while morning sessions recorded 12.08%. The occupancy report shows that evening screenings attracted the highest proportion of available seats. Morning shows had the lowest turnout among the four time slots.Aakash Kaushik makes his directorial debutWritten and directed by Aakash Kaushik, 'Udta Teer' marks his first film as a director. The spy comedy features Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan in the lead roles. The supporting cast includes Rahul Bose, Ram Kapoor, Gulshan Grover, Mukul Dev, Suhail Nayyar, Supriya Pilgaonkar, Brijendra Kala and Sandeep Anand. The film also marks the second posthumous screen appearance of Mukul Dev, who died in 2025.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalised. articles.title: Sunny Deol's 'Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak' song brings Udit Narayan and Kumar Sanu together after 21 Years; 'Suniyo Zara' teaser arrives October 26
articles.summary: Udit Narayan and Kumar Sanu have reunited for a musical collaboration after 21 years.
articles.body: Udit Narayan and Kumar Sanu have reunited for a musical collaboration after 21 years. The veteran playback singers have recorded 'Suniyo Zara', the first song from Sunny Deol's upcoming movie 'Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak'. Their last joint appearance was in 'Kahaan Ho Tum' from the 2005 movie 'No Entry'.According to Variety, the new track features their voices for Sunny Deol, Ravi Kishan and other cast members. Anupam Amod has also joined the collaboration. RAAHEE, associated with Pritam's JAM8, composed the music, while Priya Saraiya penned the lyrics. The song is expected to celebrate friendship and togetherness.Reportedly, the number unfolds like a “journey song.” The report describes it as “A vibrant, emotional track,” expected to “capture the spirit of timeless melodies that will resonate with today’s listeners.”The teaser is scheduled to release on October 26, followed by the full song on Tuesday, October 27, 2026. The collaboration also marks Udit Narayan and Kumar Sanu's first association with Sunny Deol in 24 years. Their previous playback work for the actor was in the 2002 movie 'Karz - The Burden Of Truth', which also starred Suneil Shetty and Shilpa Shetty.IMA raises objections to film's medical portrayalIn other news, Sunny Deol's upcoming movie has drawn criticism from the Indian Medical Association (IMA) over its promotional content. The organisation wrote to Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw, raising concerns about how the medical profession is represented.In its letter dated October 22, 2026, the IMA objected to what it viewed as a generalisation of corruption in healthcare. It also questioned the depiction of violence against medical professionals, warning that such portrayals could affect public trust and the safety of healthcare workers.Medical body highlights public trust concernsAccording to ANI, the IMA cautioned against presenting corruption as a widespread feature of the healthcare sector. It also raised concerns about how the portrayal of violence against doctors could influence public attitudes towards medical professionals.The letter stated, “We wish to express our serious concern regarding the portrayal of the medical profession in the film ‘SURYAA Ant Se Aarambh Tak’. Its promotional content raises concerns about the generalisation of corruption within healthcare, the depiction of violence against medical professionals, and the potential consequences for public trust and the safety of healthcare workers.”CBFC confirms movie has not been submittedThe Ministry of Information and Broadcasting clarified that the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) has not received 'Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak' for certification. The statement confirms that the certification process has not yet begun. 'Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak' also has Ravi Kishan and Pragya Jaiswal in important roles.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Aamir Khan was reportedly the first target before shooters switched to Tiger Shroff; police investigate alleged handlers
articles.summary: TRIGGER WARNING: This article contains gruesome details of violence, which could be triggering for some readers.
articles.body: TRIGGER WARNING: This article contains gruesome details of violence, which could be triggering for some readers.Police investigating the October 18 firing incident involving actor Tiger Shroff are examining reports that the alleged attackers initially planned to target Aamir Khan. According to The Indian Express, citing police reports, the suspects changed their target after struggling to approach Aamir Khan. They allegedly chose Shroff because his movements made him easier to reach. Investigators are also probing the role of alleged handlers who reportedly supplied information during the suspects’ escape.Aamir Khan was allegedly the initial targetThe alleged shooters reportedly spent nearly a month in Mumbai monitoring Aamir Khan’s movements. According to the outlet, suspects visited the vicinity of his residence at least three times. However, Khan’s frequent travel for film shoots and extended periods at home allegedly made it difficult to approach him.The suspects subsequently shifted their attention to Tiger Shroff, who reportedly played football at a Juhu park on most Sundays. The firing took place at the same location on October 18. Police sources reportedly linked the alleged plan involving Khan to threats he received in July, attributed to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang.Shooters allegedly received updates through encrypted appsInvestigators suspect the three alleged shooters received real-time information about the police operation through handlers using encrypted Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) messaging applications. According to police reports cited by PTI, news reports about the attack and the investigation helped the suspects adjust their escape plans.When television channels broadcast footage showing the suspected attackers, one of them allegedly received an urgent warning. Police sources told the outlet that the message read, “Tumhare chehre aa gaye hain, nikal jao waha se" (Your faces are out, get out of there).The three accused, Phool Singh (18), Rehan Rahisuddin Ansari (18) and Rithik Mahto (22), were arrested by Kota Police in Rajasthan on October 19 while travelling by train. Investigators reportedly found that Rehan maintained regular contact through internet-based services such as Signal or Zangi.Suspects allegedly changed transport during escapeThe alleged handlers reportedly informed the suspects about the recovery of the motorcycle used in the attack in Andheri. They also passed on information about developments surrounding their train journey, according to police reports cited by PTI.The three men allegedly switched between different modes of transport while attempting to evade arrest. They travelled by motorcycle and train, took a cab and planned to board a bus from Surat. A delay at the bus terminal reportedly forced them to take another train. Kota Police eventually apprehended them after receiving an alert from Mumbai Police.Firearms recovered as investigation expandsThe shooting occurred in Mumbai’s Juhu neighbourhood on October 18. Police said at least two men fired multiple rounds at Tiger Shroff’s car before escaping on a motorcycle. Five to six rounds were reportedly fired. Shroff escaped relatively unharmed, while his driver and a bystander sustained injuries. The motorcycle allegedly used in the incident was later recovered in Andheri.Investigators subsequently recovered two firearms and 10 live cartridges in Surat, officials told the outlet. The weapons were sent for forensic examination and ballistic testing to determine whether they matched the empty cartridges recovered at the scene.Eleven people held as police probe alleged conspiracyThe Mumbai Crime Branch and local police also apprehended 22-year-old Pranjal Thakran in Indore. Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police Rajesh Dandotia said that Thakran, originally from Sonipat in Haryana, had travelled to Indore five days earlier for his paralysed brother’s treatment.Police suspect he provided financial, logistical or operational assistance to the alleged shooters and other conspirators. His apprehension brought the total number of people held in the case to 11, with arrests reported across Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Haryana.Mumbai Police have reportedly named gangster Anil Pandit as a wanted accused. According to the report, Pandit, an alleged associate of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang believed to be operating from the United States, claimed responsibility for the firing in a social media post.A case has been registered under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Arms Act. The Crime Branch is continuing its investigation into the alleged conspiracy, the procurement of firearms and the identities of those suspected of providing weapons and logistical support. Further updates on the same are awaited.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Lalit Prabhakar reveals how watching a single YouTube video and studying two photographs helped him transform into Ajmal Kasab for Rajkummar Rao’s ‘Prahaar’: ‘The main task was perfecting the dialect and tone’
articles.summary: Lalit Prabhakar has opened up about preparing to play 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks convict Ajmal Kasab in ‘Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam’,
articles.body: Lalit Prabhakar has opened up about preparing to play 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks convict Ajmal Kasab in ‘Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam’, headlined by Rajkummar Rao. The actor revealed that conversations with director Avinash Arun, studying publicly available photographs and watching a single YouTube video of Kasab helped shape his performance. He also explained why understanding the character’s psychology and getting the dialect and tone right were crucial to bringing the role to the screen.Lalit Prabhakar on how Avinash Arun’s vision shaped his portrayal of Ajmal KasabPrabhakar knew the role offered him an opportunity to explore unfamiliar territory when he was asked to audition for Kasab. According to the actor, it took just two takes for Arun to feel that he had found the right person for the part. However, preparing for the character required considerably more work.Explaining the director’s approach, Prabhakar said to Mid Day, “I spent time with Avinash sir as he expressed his approach towards the character, how he wanted to humanise it, and didn’t want to [adopt] the melodramatic, filmy style. He believed Kasab’s psyche should be our focus. What exactly does it mean to be brainwashed? If a person has killed so many people and is ready to die, how would his eyes and expressions be?”The actor’s preparation centred on understanding the psychology behind the character rather than relying on dramatic mannerisms. Arun wanted the portrayal to focus on Kasab’s mindset, expressions and behaviour, allowing the performance to remain grounded rather than veering into a conventional, exaggerated depiction.Lalit Prabhakar reveals how one YouTube video helped him prepare for ‘Prahaar’Prabhakar also researched the case by reading 26/11 Kasab Ani Me, a book by Ramesh Mahale, the chief investigating officer of the Mumbai terror attacks. He supplemented his reading with the limited visual material of Kasab available publicly.“There’s only one video of Kasab available on YouTube. That’s all I could watch. I studied his two-three photos that are in public domain. The main task was [perfecting] the dialect and tone,” the actor said.The limited availability of footage meant that Prabhakar had to pay close attention to the material he could access. He focused particularly on reproducing Kasab’s speech patterns and tone, while also considering the character’s expressions and psychological state.About ‘Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam’Directed by Avinash Arun, ‘Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam’ revisits the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks and the legal proceedings that followed, focusing on public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam’s role in the case against Kasab.Rajkummar Rao plays Nikam, while Prabhakar portrays Kasab. The film also features Wamiqa Gabbi, Jaideep Ahlawat, Sikandar Kher and Ashish Vidyarthi in key roles. The courtroom drama brings the prosecution and trial into focus, with the confrontation between Nikam and Kasab forming a central part of the narrative.With respect to the film's box office performance, by Day 10, the film's total domestic earnings to stood at Rs. 20.10 crore net and Rs. 23.93 crore gross. Internationally, its overall worldwide gross stood at Rs. 26.78 crore.Lalit Prabhakar’s upcoming projectsFollowing his appearance in ‘Prahaar’, Prabhakar has several projects in different stages of development. He is set to portray poet and Dalit Panther co-founder Namdeo Dhasal in the biopic ‘Dhasal’, with music by Ilaiyaraaja.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
